reason: The three transformations and their separation are reviewed from the pinned FIA device-tiling-sink, GQA/BN2S layout and A5 FlashMLA source families and from the installed operator contracts. No paired timing, hidden-input campaign or leave-one-out run was executed for this combination, so this receipt establishes no speedup and no cross-SOC applicability.

factors.change: Remove the per-step host traversal of actual_seq_lengths_kv and build FIA/FlashMLA tiling metadata on device from persistent length buffers; keep the host list only for backends whose schema requires SymInt[].
signals: host .tolist()/.item() over seq_lens in the replay path
graph re-capture when only sequence lengths changed
host gap grows with num_reqs under ACLGraph

factors.change: View contiguous BNSD query [B, N_q, S_q, D] as [B, N_kv, G*S_q, D] with G = N_q / N_kv and feed Cube BMM1 directly, instead of materializing a transpose+contiguous GM copy; expand the causal mask by G and invert the view on output.
signals: Transpose or TensorMove task before the first Cube task
high aic_mte2_time relative to the query bytes

factors.change: When B * N_kv < num_cores, split the KV axis so the product reaches the core count, compute partial out and lse per shard, mask the tail block, and combine with the online-softmax formula in fp32 with a deterministic order.
signals: low aic_mac_time and aiv_time with long wall time
Block Dim below the core count on a long-KV small-batch decode

leave_one_out_arms.purpose: separate host tiling and graph re-capture cost from the device-side layout and split factors
measure the transpose+contiguous copy that the fold removes
measure the occupancy gain against the workspace and fp32 combine cost
interaction check between host tiling and layout
interaction check between host tiling and the split-KV reduction
interaction check between layout and the split-KV reduction

fallback_boundary.host_list_mandatory: If the installed backend validates actual_seq_lengths_kv as SymInt[] and cannot consume a device tensor, keep the host list and re-capture per shape; do not claim the device tiling sink.
fallback_boundary.non_viewable_strides: If N_q != N_kv * G, or the BSND/NZ stride cannot express [B, N_kv, G*S_q, D], do not force a view; materialize outside the hot path or retain the baseline copy.
fallback_boundary.mask_not_expandable: If the operator mask cannot be tiled by G, the fold changes semantics; fall back to the ungrouped path.
fallback_boundary.short_kv_or_enough_parallelism: If B * N_kv >= num_cores or S_kv is below the minimum profitable shard, do not split.
fallback_boundary.no_fp32_lse: If softmax_lse is not exposed or only bf16 is available, do not form the fp32 combine; a bf16 combine is not equivalent.
fallback_boundary.bit_exact_requirement: Split-KV changes the reduction order; if the acceptance criterion is bit-exact against a single-pass reference, the split factor is out of scope.

retention_rule: Only both_pass hidden cases with valid paired timings enter a speedup ratio; guard workloads are evaluated separately and a local gain cannot override a guard regression. A candidate that changes correctness is treated as a prerequisite failure, not as a performance factor.
